Subject: Partner claim rebalance: GlimmerTech - Atlas & Kernelytics

Team / Partners —

Thanks for the quick cadence on GlimmerTech. To summarize where we are: both Atlas Consulting and Kernelytics have active opportunities in the same account (GlimmerTech) across the data platform and integration tracks. The executive sponsor at GlimmerTech (Rachel) made it clear last week they expect a single routing/engagement plan — we need to present a clean co-sell handoff by EOW.

I’m proposing a short, operational rebalance so both partners can sell without stepping on each other:
- Atlas: primary for integration services + proofs of concept (50% territory credit for integration work)
- Kernelytics: primary for data platform customization and AI connectors (50% territory credit for platform deals)
- Joint AE intro on any cross-sell > $150k, with 60/40 rev credit where the majority of seats come from the primary partner

Next steps I need from each of you:
- Marissa: confirm the proposed revenue/lead split and quick legal checklist for partner T&Cs.
- Jonas: ops ask — will partner portal updates and lead routing change be simple to handle? See attachment for RACI and proposed mapping.
- Matthew / Atlas: confirm you’re okay with the 50/50 split on territory-level credits and the joint-intro rule.

Attachments: GlimmerTech_claim_map_v2.xlsx (proposed account map), partner-rebalance-MAP.pdf (one-pager for GlimmerTech execs).

Rachel — copying you so you have the plan; happy to adjust if GlimmerTech prefers a different handoff cadence.

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

> Thanks for the quick cadence on GlimmerTech...

Thanks Hannah — this direction looks good to me. Operational notes from the sales side:

1) Revenue and credit split: 50/50 at the territory level is acceptable, but we should include a weighted split for deals where one partner provides >65% of billable services. My suggested fallback: 70/30 in favor of the partner supplying the majority of services (we'll use logged opportunity line items to adjudicate).

2) Lead routing: we should set routing rules in partner portal so inbound leads from GlimmerTech go to the primary partner unless flagged by the GlimmerTech AE for cross-sell.

3) Legal/commercial checklist: small addendum to our standard partner MOU — covers co-selling, NRE credits, and data-handling responsibilities. I’ll loop in legal if Hannah thumbs up.

I attached a quick draft RACI and a short draft note for AE talking points (see attached spreadsheet). If everyone agrees, I recommend we present this as a single page to Rachel and lock the routing by Friday.

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Appreciate the clarity — from Kernelytics' side we’re comfortable with the 50/50 territory split as long as the following are true:
- Lead assignment is deterministic (portal routing) so we don’t have repeated duplicate outreach.
- There’s a simple escalation path to a joint AE review for any disputed leads.
- We get a single joint-delivery steering call for the first 60 days post-sale to sync integration touchpoints.

We can do the joint AE intro next Wednesday (Nov 17) between 10–11am PT. Rachel — does that work for you?

Quick note: we request an explicit listing of NRE vs. recurring revenue in the adjudication so we can apply our services SE discounts correctly. Happy to have legal sign the small MOU addendum Marissa mentioned.
